lessons.trigger_condition: v372 can retrain one verified model and emit non-executable feature proposals, but it cannot learn which safe action works best from verified outcomes or self-add bounded operational behaviors without source-code edits
lessons.symptom_summary: the tablet still depends on fixed action priorities and manual code changes for every new operational adaptation, so repeated market coverage/source-health patterns are detected but not converted into reusable self-evolving runtime policies
lessons.fix_pattern: add a local meta neural network trained only from verified outcome records; bound its action-priority influence; synthesize and auto-activate only allowlisted declarative operational capabilities such as region prioritization, degraded-source retry policy, freshness refresh request, safe-learning priority and increased observation; keep source-code generation, arbitrary commands, Git/main writes, verification/trust/fact promotion and market-direction invention forbidden
